Incentive-compatible MPL design, local redemption equalizes transaction costs, slum/round controls, random effects with clustered SEs. Sensitivity checks on bounds. Constraints: upper cap on cash, midpoint/bound imputations, exclusion of multiple switchers, no preregistration.
Provides rare direct DWL/DWG estimates for in-kind, links to intra-household bargaining, and yields actionable insight (offer choice). Fills gap between theory and program design in LMIC safety nets.

Clear setup, sampling, procedures, and theory appendix; coherent interpretation; alternative explanations discussed. Minor gaps: broader external validity, multiplicity/accounting for learning dynamics could be tighter.

Highly relevant to social protection design (PDS scale), with practical implications for cash vs in-kind and beneficiary choice. Generalizability beyond setting and to other goods may vary.

Nationwide geo-randomized field experiment; measures total donations across channels; robust checks incl. spillovers and competition; practical ROI. Limits: modest precision on revenue, proprietary aggregated data, some prereg deviations.

Clear main questions; randomization supports causality; DiD and randomization inference bolster claims. Frequency effects strong; revenue effects modest but consistent. Crowding-out shown via two datasets; claims are appropriately scoped.

Large blocked geo-randomization, preregistration, justified winsorization, robustness, spillover analysis, heterogeneity, factorial treatments. Constraints: PLZ aggregation, minor imbalance, proprietary data, some analytical choices ex post.
Provides rare, externally valid evidence on online fundraising, long-term effects, and inter-charity substitution; shows click metrics can mislead. Strong applied value; theoretical novelty moderate.
Clear setup, transparent assumptions, coherent conclusions; figures/tables informative; ROI assumptions discussed. Length and complexity may obscure key points for non-specialists.

High practical relevance for NGOs and digital fundraising internationally; provides cost-effect estimates. Less direct impact on broader global priority outcomes beyond nonprofit effectiveness.

Careful comparative study bridging epidemiology and applied micro. Strong, policy-relevant findings favoring reduced-form severity proxies; robust checks. Novelty moderate but execution strong.

Well-structured, transparent assumptions, consistent interpretations; figures/tables clear; limitations openly discussed.
Relies on public datasets and documents methods well, but no evident replication package/code release; some processing steps not fully reproducible from text alone.
